question: Does matched substitution of the current Hebrew full-morph operator selectively damage its fit to the anonymous proximal post-operator structure localized by V29?
claimBoundary: A positive result supports counterfactual structural dependence under the frozen V29 masked-transition projector: the observed anonymous +1/+2 neighborhood is better fit by the actual operator realization than by a matched substitute, beyond equally sized pre-operator and farther post-operator controls. It does not establish semantics, textual causation, a unique generating mechanism, or Hebrew-glyph equivalence.

hebrewSplit.assignment: Sort canonical book osisIDs by sha256(salt + ':' + book). Assign rank modulo 5 residues 0,1,2 TRAIN; 3 holdout; 4 control.

masking.method: Inherit V29 exactly: for each origin occurrence independently, replace the current operator identity with a unique sentinel before computing every target signature.

signature.definition: Inherit V29 exactly: at target j=i+d in the masked verse, signature = ordered pair [anonymous four-history state immediately before j, anonymous four-history state immediately after j].

stratification.baselineKey: signed distance + origin-position bucket + unit-length bin

substitutions.matching: Freeze from TRAIN only. Candidates must be frozen V29-model operators. Rank by V29 frequency-bin distance, then absolute log2 origin-frequency difference, then L1 distance between TRAIN origin-position profiles, then lexical operator key. No sealed event signature or outcome participates in matching.
substitutions.sameLemmaDifferentFullMorph: same lemma; different complete morphology string
substitutions.differentLemmaSameFullMorph: different lemma; identical complete morphology string
substitutions.bothChangedControl: different lemma; different complete morphology string
substitutions.positionProfile: distribution over the frozen V29 origin-position buckets, counted once per origin

models.baseline: P(signature | distance, origin-position bucket, unit-length bin), inherited V29 smoothing
models.operator: P(signature | operator, distance, origin-position bucket, unit-length bin), inherited V29 hierarchical smoothing
models.eventDamage: log2 Pactual_operator(signature_actual) - log2 Psubstitute_operator(signature_actual); V29 baseline cancels algebraically
models.operatorDistanceDamage: average eventDamage within actual operator and signed distance
models.operatorBandDamage: average operatorDistanceDamage over the two predeclared distances in each band
models.primaryClassStatistic: operator-balanced mean D_local(op) over qualified actual operators

null.construction: Paired operator-level sign-flip null on frozen D_local(op) values within each substitution class. This preserves matched substitutes, evaluation signatures, effect magnitudes, operator support, smoothing, and all six frozen distances while testing exchangeability of actual versus substitute identity.
null.pValue: one-sided (1 + number null means >= observed mean) / (permutations + 1)

evaluation.replicationRule: A substitution class passes only if mean D_local > 0 and sign-flip p<=.05 independently in BOTH sealed holdout and control lanes.
evaluation.positiveControlExpected: bothChangedControl should show positive local selectivity if the perturbation score is responsive, but it does not determine the scientific adjudication.
